premises.text: The conditions today are similar to past technological revolutions that made computers personal and accessible.
premises.evidence_span: the conditions today, economical and technological, are very similar to different revolutions that moved us from this computer's large, expensive, difficult to use, to this computer's personal and in every home.

premises.text: Advances in miniaturization and rapid manufacturing reduce costs and improve accessibility of robots.
premises.evidence_span: the trends that are similar are not only miniaturization and advances in rapid manufacturing and commercialization and manufacturing, reduction of costs of components.

premises.text: Smartphone and cloud robotics can make robots more affordable and upgradable.
premises.evidence_span: smartphone robotics and cloud robotics that takes a computation from the robot into devices you already have, make it much more affordable, and also automatically and dynamically upgradable.

premises.text: Targeted robots performing limited tasks can be more affordable and gradually integrated into homes.
premises.evidence_span: we're going to have a set of robots that are much more targeted at limited set of tasks that can slowly get into the house because they're more affordable.

premises.text: The Shimmy robot uses smartphone capabilities for entertainment and functional tasks.
premises.evidence_span: Shimmy is a robotic speaker dog that doesn't just play the music for you. It actually listens to it and enjoys it as much as you do.

premises.text: Cloud computing enables real-time choreography and functionality in the robot.
premises.evidence_span: it's taking information from the cloud that has the beats, the segments, where the chorus starts, where the verse starts, what genre of the song is.

value.text: Personal robotics can become engaging, affordable, and functional for home use.
